name: Orbit Baby G5 Stroller

clekListed.clekRow: Orbit Baby G5 — Car Seat Stroller Adapter

specs._weightNote: Stroller = frame 19.6 lb + stroller seat 13.8 lb = 33.4 lb (per orbitbaby.com). Some retailer listings cite ~47 lb total including an infant car seat.
specs._unfoldedNote: Orbit publishes frame width 24 in and handlebar height range 40–46.5 in; overall in-use length not published (null). Interior seat 21 in H × 13.5 in W.
specs._foldedNote: Frame-only folded 32.5 × 15.5 × 13 in; with seat attached 32.5 × 15.5 × 14 in.

capacity.minAgeOrNewborn: birth (modular — infant car seat / stroller seat reclines flat) to 50 lb

specs._capacityNote: Basket size published as 22 × 54 × 24 in interior dims; weight limit not published (null).

safety.standards: ASTM F2050 and ASTM F833; CPSIA compliant
safety.certifications: JPMA Certified; CA Prop 65 and AB1108 compliant
safety.notes: 360° SmartHub seat rotation; 5-point harness; Quadshock front-wheel suspension; memory-foam cushioning.

specs.tires: no-flat E-TPU rear wheels; EVA foam no-pump front wheels; 360° swivel with Quadshock suspension

notes: Modular luxury stroller with 360° SmartHub reversible/rotating seat. ~33.4 lb (frame+seat). $1,200 MSRP, in stock at Orbit Baby DTC, Strolleria and Bambi Baby. On Clek's official Liing/Liingo list via the Orbit Baby 'Car Seat Stroller Adapter' (adapter-orbitbaby-g5), which lists Clek Liing. Note the adapter attaches a non-Orbit infant seat and does NOT work with Orbit's own car-seat base.
